valor: A 62-year-old woman, trapped in a life of empty privilege, becomes pregnant by her driver. Facing rejection from her family and society, she decides to fight to bring to life a baby that seems impossible at her late age, regardless of the consequences.

quien: Claude, recomendación (Juan: «sigue con género y sinopsis en inglés»)
